description: This file defines the EmployeeLicenseDao class, which manages database operations related to EmployeeLicense entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching employee licenses, as well as handling pagination and filtering.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for EmployeeLicense entities, providing methods for CRUD operations, searches, and permission filtering related to employee licenses.

methods.name: saveEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeLicense entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmployeeLicense by employee number and license ID.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeLicenses
methods.description: Deletes multiple EmployeeLicense records for a specific employee.

methods.name: searchEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Searches for EmployeeLicense records based on filter parameters, utilizing pagination.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeLicensesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of EmployeeLicense records matching the search filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedLicenses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of licenses allowed for a specific employee, with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedLicensesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of allowed licenses for a specific employee, with filters applied.
